en.content: In graphite and diamond, the percentage of p-characters of the hybrid orbitals in hybridisation are respectively :
en.explanation:
Hybridization of carbon in graphite is sp2.

So,   %   of p - in graphite = = 67%

Hybridization of carbon in diamond is sp3 .

So,   %   of p - in diamond = = 75%

en.content: For Na<sup>+</sup>, Mg<sup>2+</sup>, F<sup>-</sup> and O<sup>2-</sup>; the correct order of increasing ionic radii is :
en.explanation:
Here all of them are isoelectric. For isoelectric anion size is more than cation. 
Among two anions which anion has more negative charge will have more radius and among two cation which cation has less positive charge will have more radius.
